scripts.device:start: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator.exe\" -ArgumentList '-avd','pixel','-memory','4096'" && adb start-server && adb wait-for-device && adb shell "while [ -z \"$(getprop sys.boot_completed)\" ]; do sleep 2; done"
scripts.start: adb install -r apps/mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n io.github.wonderwall1995.cypress_realworld_for_personal_portfolio_mobile/.MainActivity
scripts.device:stop: adb shell am force-stop io.github.wonderwall1995.cypress_realworld_for_personal_portfolio_mobile & adb emu kill
scripts.test: node tests/e2e/check-header.mjs && tsx tests/e2e/preflight.ts && wdio run wdio.conf.ts
